effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may play 1 [Dorumon] or [Ryudamon] from your hand to your empty breeding area without paying the cost. Then, if during an attack, until the end of your opponent's turn, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.) and gets +5000 DP.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] This Digimon doesn't activate [Security] effects on Option cards it checks.
